fields.name: EleViewer
fields.tagline: Free portable Windows study workspace — open DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, MD, CSV, HTML, TXT without Office
fields.description: EleViewer is a free, open-source portable Windows study workspace. It opens DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, Markdown, CSV, HTML, and TXT files in one ~135MB executable — no Microsoft Office, no installer, no admin rights, no account. Built-in PDF text-to-speech uses native Windows voices (SAPI) for hands-free reading. Features include a vault sidebar for course folders, session restore, split-screen web browser, quick switcher (Ctrl+Q), and persistent bookmarks. Zero telemetry, fully offline, GPLv3 licensed. Ideal for students, researchers, and anyone on locked-down or shared computers.
